dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 06, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
"AL East Showdown: Angels Soar to 4-1 Win, Orioles Fall"

The Los Angeles Angels took down the Baltimore Orioles 4-1 behind a strong team effort on the mound. Wade Meckler and Zach Neto led the offense, with Neto delivering a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance. Mitch Farris earned the win for the Angels, while Luke Murphy impressed in relief with 1.1 scoreless innings and 3 strikeouts. In other action, the New York Mets trounced the Cleveland Guardians 13-6, with Luis Torrens contributing a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI night.
